_instructions: Copy the 'Validate_Auth_Token' scope below into your flow's Main_Flow.actions. Place it after Validate_Input and before your business logic. Update runAfter to match your preceding action name if different. Also add 'authToken' to your flow's trigger schema (see _trigger_schema_addition).

authToken.description: Auth token from OTP verification. Required for all authenticated flows.

Validate_Auth_Token.description: Validates the auth token against the sessions table; returns 200 + UNAUTHORIZED then Terminate(Succeeded) if missing, unknown, or expired. ROW-LEVEL SECURITY: scope every query by the session's user id, never triggerBody. See RECIPE.md 'H1'.

IMPLEMENT_Get_Auth_Session.description: Look up the session record by token. [IMPLEMENT]: (1) replace entityName with your session table plural name (e.g. smkb_sol_sessions). (2) replace smkb_sol_token in $filter with your token field schema name.

If_Token_Not_Found.description: No session record for this token — caller is unauthenticated or presented a forged/expired token. Return 200 + UNAUTHORIZED, then Terminate(Succeeded).

If_Token_Expired.description: Token exists but its expiry is in the past: 200 + UNAUTHORIZED, then Terminate(Succeeded). [IMPLEMENT] Replace the expiry field with your schema name. Only runs when the token WAS found - If_Token_Not_Found terminates the run otherwise.

Respond_token_expired.description: Return UNAUTHORIZED for an expired token.
